captureMethod: Complete initialized public legacy DOM captured in an anonymous browser with ccxpLite absent. Original tables, classes, inline styles, notices, form action, compact Turnstile container and service links retained.
sanitization: Account, password, code, and legacy fnstr values cleared. Submit retains its public label.
Explicit form1 id/form attributes restore the parser-associated external fnstr field after DOM serialization.
Host scripts and event handlers removed; calendar iframe set to about:blank.
Cloudflare-generated closed-shadow widget contents and response removed; public production sitekey and callback attribute retained as host landmarks. No tokens or challenges are replayed.
Existing host assets reused; css/style.css verified against the live stylesheet on capture date, identical after newline normalization.

The opt-in network browser test restores the observed host callback and official Cloudflare script, substitutes Cloudflare's documented always-pass test sitekey, and intercepts all CCXP page requests and submissions locally. Only Cloudflare widget requests use the network. Test keys are never used by the extension runtime.
limitations: Offline packaged captures show the host form before the external widget renders; closed-shadow challenge internals cannot be serialized.

The opt-in network test verifies the real test widget, desktop/mobile layout, callback and intercepted POST. Production challenge acceptance and authenticated CCXP server processing require a live user sign-in.
Other role-specific source variants are not recaptured.
